classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: GO:0034021 encodes ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity and GO:0034018 encodes NADPHX epimerase activity per GO consortium annotations for the NAD(P)HX repair system.
Reviewed-only (Swiss-Prot) entries are retrieved to maximize annotation confidence; IEA (electronic) evidence codes are excluded for higher-quality associations.
No taxon filter is applied, yielding representative coverage across both prokaryotic and eukaryotic NAD(P)HX repair homologs (e.g., bacterial YjeF and human CARKD/NAXE families).
sequence_analysis runs on the FASTA output from each go_sequences node; representative_sequences and metrics outputs serve as candidate and analysis inputs to rank_designs.
No dedicated sequence-clustering tool is available; go_sequences deduplication and sequence_analysis representative_sequences selection serve as the diversity proxy for the representative set.
rank_designs aggregates both sequence_analysis outputs into a unified ranked candidate list using default scoring weights.
Literature search runs in parallel with GO retrieval to provide pathway-level validation context without blocking the analysis pipeline.
Up to 200 reviewed sequences per GO term is sufficient to capture characterized diversity without exceeding memory limits.
plan.goal: Retrieve UniProt sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0034021) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0034018) activities, characterize their biochemical properties via sequence analysis, and rank representative candidates.

success_criteria.dehydratase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences for GO:0034021 returns at least 1 reviewed sequence with a valid fasta_path
success_criteria.epimerase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences for GO:0034018 returns at least 1 reviewed sequence with a valid fasta_path
success_criteria.literature_context_collected: literature_search returns publications covering NAD(P)HX repair pathway biology with text-mined annotations
success_criteria.sequences_characterized: sequence_analysis produces representative_sequences and metrics for both GO term sets
success_criteria.candidates_ranked: rank_designs returns ranked_candidates covering both dehydratase and epimerase activity classes with at least 1 entry

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair dehydratase epimerase NADPHX metabolite damage
